card.name: Dose-size comparisons and dose wording
card.fires_on: Words that end or follow a dose description, such as 'used' after 'those', a closing parenthesis after a per-day dose, 'mg', '/kg', 'dose', 'doses' or 'regimen'. It fires where dose level or amount is being compared or specified.

modes.label: Comparing to doses used
modes.description: The word 'used' after 'those' when one dose is compared with doses used for another purpose.
modes.example: comparable to those<< used>> to treat cancer of the prostate and breast

modes.label: Dose unit or amount end
modes.description: A unit or closing mark right after a dose amount.
modes.example: With pomalidomide and dexamethasone: 10 mg<</kg>> administered intravenously every week

modes.label: Dose nouns after level words
modes.description: The words dose, doses or regimen after high, same, conventional or divided.
modes.example: Among 4,483 such patients who received conventional<< doses>> of AC

card.plain: It lights up where the text is stating or comparing how much of a drug is given, such as high, usual or divided doses.
